preview.text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the person in <Video 1>.
<Subject 2> is the person in <Image 1> to <Image 5>: young woman, no tattoos.
<Video 1> is the source video.

summary:
[video editing + character replacement] <Subject 1> is replaced by <Subject 2>. <Subject 2> copies <Subject 1>'s facial performance exactly, frame by frame and with the same intensity: every eye movement, side glance, blink, eyebrow raise and head turn, at the same moments, and the same body motion. The camera, the exact framing and crop, the background and the lighting of <Video 1> stay unchanged. Any caption or on-screen text is removed.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1>: fully_preserved - camera motion, framing and crop, background, lighting and timing.
<Subject 1>: replaced - only the facial expressions, mouth movements and body motion are kept, not the face, hair, tattoos, jewellery or clothes.
<Subject 2>: reference - face and identity from <Image 1> and <Image 2>.

detailed_description:
Casual phone video, realistic. [Shot 1] <Subject 2> in the same place, framed exactly like <Subject 1>: keep the exact framing and crop of <Video 1>, the camera does not pull back. The face is fully alive and mirrors every expression of <Subject 1>. Sharp face matching <Image 1>, natural skin texture, no beauty filter. No text anywhere. <Subject 2>'s mouth follows <Video 1> exactly; she does not speak, sing or mouth words.
Direction from the user: smiling, glancing at the camera
